nodes.title: INPUT - MiniMax H3 Latent Upscale Model
READ ME - MiniMax H3 DMAD + Long Scenes
widgets_values:
# MiniMax H3 · DMAD + Long Scenes (2 Pass)

The same graph the **VRGDG Video Builder** renders when a scene uses **2 Pass**, **DMAD** and **Long Scenes** (pass 2 in batches). It is generated from the Builder's own code, with the Builder's default values.

**How it works**
1. **Pass 1** renders the whole scene at low resolution in 4 DMAD steps.
2. **Pass 2** upscales and refines it in short overlapping windows (3 s windows, 1.6 s locked overlap). Only one window is on the GPU at a time, so long scenes (up to ~15 s) fit in memory.
3. **Audio**: one switch, `built_in_audio` on the **AUDIO** node in group 3.
   - **Off (my song)**: your song is locked in, and H3 makes only the picture.
   - **On (built-in audio)**: H3 makes the singing and sound itself, and no song file is needed.

**Use it**
1. Load your reference pictures in group **3**.
2. Choose the audio mode. For your song, set `audio_file` and the scene start (`seek_seconds`).
3. Set **Duration**.
4. Write the prompt for that mode (see the note in group 3). Pass 2 gets a copy without the lyric text and times automatically.
5. Queue.

**Node packs needed**
- ComfyUI with the MiniMax H3 nodes (recent ComfyUI)
- **VRGDG Custom Node Pack**: pass 2 prompt and the audio switch
- **comfyui-vrgamedevgirl** (Video Builder): VRGDG H3 Chunked Pass 2 and the latent upscaler loader
- Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler: the learned latent upscaler itself
- ComfyUI-KJNodes
- ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite

**Model files**
- `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors` -> `models/diffusion_models`
- `qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors` -> `models/text_encoders`
- `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors` -> `models/vae`
- `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors` -> `models/vae`
- `minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_bf16.safetensors` -> `models/latent_upscale_models`
- `dmad_minimax_h3_4step_full_critic_comfyui.safetensors` -> `models/loras`
- `minimax_h3_open_regenerate_2k_refiner_rank_16_bf16.safetensors` -> `models/loras`

DMAD LoRA: huggingface.co/ZhengmingYu/DMAD (folder `minimax_h3`)
Refiner LoRA: huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental (folder `loras`)
In the Video Builder: Models > DMAD Models installs both.

nodes.title: Note - Models
widgets_values:
**Models**

The H3 Reference-to-Video model, its text encoder, both VAEs and the learned latent upscaler.

`sage_attention` auto and fp16 accumulation are the Builder defaults. Set them to off if your setup does not support them.

nodes.title: Note - DMAD LoRAs
widgets_values:
**DMAD**

- **Pass 1** uses the **DMAD 4-step LoRA** (strength 1) and a **sigma shift of 12 video / 2 audio**.
- **Pass 2** uses the **Refiner LoRA** at **0.7**.

**Chunk FeedForward** (KJNodes) is on for both passes. The Builder turns it on for every scene over 8 s, so long scenes stay inside memory.

Keep the DMAD LoRA on pass 1 only: its 4-step sampler does not work without it.

nodes.title: Note - Your inputs
widgets_values:
**Your inputs**

- **References**: `<Picture 1>` and `<Picture 2>` in the prompt are these images, in order. To add more, drag another Load Image into the next `ref_image` slot of **both** Reference to Video nodes in group 4. With more than 5 pictures, set `ref_image_size` to `match` on both (the Builder does this).
- **Audio switch** (`built_in_audio`):
  - **Off, my song**: `audio_file` is the full path to your song, or a file name in `ComfyUI/input`. `seek_seconds` is where the scene starts in the song; the length comes from **Duration**. The prompt calls the song `<Audio 1>`.
  - **On, built-in audio**: H3 sings and makes the sound itself, and `audio_file` is ignored. In the prompt, do not mention `<Audio 1>`. Describe the voice once, and put the words to sing in the `<d>` cues: `sings from 1.0 s to 4.4 s, <d>[English, warm singing] the words</d>`.
- **Duration**: the scene length in seconds (H3 renders up to ~15 s). It is rounded up to H3's frame grid, so the video can be a few frames longer than the audio. The Builder trims that off; trim it in your editor.
- **Width / Height**: the final video size. Pass 1 renders at this size divided by the **Upscale Scale**.
- **Prompt**: the Builder's six-section H3 format works best. Lyric cues are `from 1.0 s to 4.4 s, <d>[tags] words</d>`, with times counted from the scene start.

nodes.title: Note - Conditioning
widgets_values:
**Conditioning**

- The first Reference to Video node reads your prompt for pass 1.
- **Pass 2 Prompt (No Lyric Times)** removes the lyric cues, sung words and shot times. Each pass 2 window starts its own clock at 0, so whole-scene times would mislead it. The second Reference to Video node conditions the windows with that text.
- **Lock song** puts your song into the latent, so H3 generates the picture only and the singing stays in sync. With built-in audio it passes the latent through, and H3 makes the sound too.
- With built-in audio, the Reference to Video nodes get no reference audio. The AUDIO node sends nothing to `ref_audio_0`, which is the same as the Builder's built-in graph.

nodes.title: Note - Pass 1
widgets_values:
**Pass 1 · DMAD**

`lcm` / `simple` / **4 steps** / denoise 1, at low resolution. These are the DMAD defaults; there is no need to raise the steps.

Change the **seed** for a different take.

nodes.title: Note - Pass 2 in windows
widgets_values:
**Pass 2 · in windows**

`res_multistep` / `simple` / **3 steps** / denoise **0.2** (DMAD defaults).

**VRGDG H3 Chunked Pass 2** does the learned upscale and the refinement one window at a time, then joins them. The Builder's values:
- `chunk_seconds` 3: window length
- `overlap_seconds` 1.6, `overlap_mode` locked: each window keeps the end of the one before it fixed, so there are no seams
- `tail_trim_seconds` 0.7: each window's last part is redone by the next one
- `upscale` per_window: the upscaler also works one window at a time

The Builder uses windows only for clips longer than 8 s. For a short scene this node still works; it just makes fewer windows.

The **Window report** shows the windows that ran.

nodes.title: Note - Decode and save
widgets_values:
**Decode + save**

The refined latent is decoded, resized to your exact width x height and saved as an MP4 in `output/`.

**Video soundtrack** is your song, or with built-in audio the sound H3 made in pass 1 (pass 2 keeps that audio exactly).
